Ashley: Evening folks — quick handoff before I sign off in ~30m. TL;DR: rolled a small prefetch tweak to embeddings canary, validated on staging, promoted to canary lane at 18:20 UTC. No rollback yet but watch rerank tail latency and cache miss rate.

Ashley: What changed: 
- Prefetch client now batches user-context keys up to 8 instead of 4 for the hot path (config flag `PREFETCH_BATCH=8`).
- Short window KV eviction disabled for canary nodes (`kv_ttl_short=false`).
- Canary traffic at ~5% routed to `emb-service-v3b` (same weights as previous canary).

Ashley: Why: we saw a small spike in per-request RPC count during long conversations; batching should reduce per-token overhead. Risk: increased memory pressure and slightly higher cold-start latency for rare keys.

deploy-bot: [deploy] embedding-service v3b promoted to canary (5% traffic) by Ashley at 2026-03-18T18:20:12Z — checks: unit tests ok, smoketests ok, infra-checks ok.

Mike: Thanks — noted. I'll keep an eye on `embeddings/canary` dashboard. Which panels are best to watch? :eyes:

Ashley: Watch these three: `prefetch/miss_rate`, `redis/mem_used_percent_by_node`, and `rerank/99th_ms`. Also look at `ingress/5xx_by_route`. Link: https://dash.redwood/ops/embeddings/canary

Leah: Quick FYI — I bumped the autoscaler for dedicated-worker pool yesterday to target 18 -> 24 nodes for the evening load. That should give some headroom if prefetch increases memory.

Priya: Pinged you on the PR for the config flag cleanup (PR #4123) — canary manifest change + unit test. Can someone review? It's small but I'd rather not hold the rollback knob behind my queue.

Mike: I'll take PR #4123 now.

Priya: Thanks. If anyone oncall sees `OOM` on `emb-service` nodes, please escalate immediately — the canary will get isolated but if the eviction config isn't effective we might need to revert.

Ashley: Action items before I go: 
- Mike: watch the three metrics, post a quick status at +15m and +45m.
- Leah: confirm no unintended autoscaler churn; set a light alert threshold for mem usage at 78%.
- Priya: ping when PR merged.
- All: if `rerank/99th_ms` increases >20% for 10m, we rollback.

Mike: Ack. I'll post updates. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Alert rule created: `embeddings_canary_mem_warning` — triggers at 78% mem usage sustained 10m. Created by Leah.

Leah: Added a short-runbook note in Confluence: "canary-memory-checks" with the `kubectl` commands. See section 2 for quick rollback steps.

Ashley: Quick commands if needed:
```
# check pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=emb-service-canary
# check mem
kubectl -n prod top pod <pod-name> --containers
# scale down canary
kubectl -n prod scale deploy emb-service-canary --replicas=0
```

Priya: PR merged (4123) — canary manifest updated, flag is behind feature gate.

Mike: +15m check: `prefetch/miss_rate` down ~12% vs baseline, `redis/mem_used_percent_by_node` trending up but at 62%, `rerank/99th_ms` unchanged. No 5xx spikes. So far so good.

Ashley: Great. If things stay stable I'll remove myself from rotation at 19:00. Leaving a note in the post-shift doc.

Priya: One minor thing — observed a single `OOMKilled` on a canary pod at 18:35 but it restarted and hasn't recurred. Logs attached in the PR.

Mike: saw the OOM log — looks like a burst from a long-convo test. Pod restarted and metrics smoothed out. I bumped the mem alert to warn earlier so we catch repeated events.

Ashley: If OOMs recur, rollback immediately and open a ticket for memory profiling.

Leah: Will do. Also FYI: dedicated-worker autoscaler scaled one extra node at 18:40, then stabilized. No thrash.

Ashley: Final: Oncall watchlist for the next shift: `embeddings canary`, `redis shard 3` memory, `rerank 99th`, and any `5xx` increase on `/v1/rerank`. If you need me after 19:00 ping DM @Ashley or add to #eng-oncall and tag `@oncall-sre`.

Mike: Thanks — posting followups in 30.

Priya: Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:

deploy-bot: [status] canary health check OK at 2026-03-18T18:55:01Z (duration 35m).
